a9_1_rule: at a backend and load, at least 90% of negative readings spent more than half of the time from arrival to stamp waiting for a CPU
a9_2b_predicted_as: the share of acknowledgements whose own wait outlasted T - g (A9-2b)
predicted_as: the sum of max(0, W - (T - g)) over the stamping thread's waits, over the window's length (A9-2)
rule: at least two thirds of setups predict their measured rate within 0.67-1.5, and the median ratio is at least 0.8
